What customers are saying

The coffee maker offers a variety of features, including the ability to brew different coffee drinks and produce high-quality milk froth. Many users praise its ease of use and the delicious coffee it makes. However, some customers have experienced issues with the frother malfunctioning or the machine breaking down within the first year of use. Despite these occasional quality control problems, the majority of users are satisfied with the product and would recommend it.

  • Customer rating: 5 out of 5 stars

    Keurig K-cafe is K-o yay

    Reviewed by Bill_W - June 28, 2026

    Had to replace my Keurig Elite K-90 (absolutely the best K machine we ever had). It eventually failed after 7 years of daily use. I was going to replace it with same but doing my research I found this model. I had never considered a frother machine before. This K-Cafe is normally the same price as the K-90, Bestbuy had a $60 off sale. It makes great coffee using normal pods but it also has the option to make cappuccinos and lattes I always use filtered water so I'm hoping it lasts as long as my last one. Same ability for pods, plus the ability for some fun coffees ... no brainer.

    Yes, I would recommend this to a friend.

  • Customer rating: 5 out of 5 stars

    Great machine for various drinks

    Verified BuyerReviewed by Redfox - April 15, 2022

    Got this machine because we are fans of cappuccinos and lattes (hot and cold) and wanted to be able to have machine that could provide us with various options for us and our guests. I can say after a month that it's a very good choice. The machine is very quiet and the warming up time is short (around 20sec). We love having many options and it's very easy to use. Loving the almost automatic functions to make a latte/ cap: pour milk up to the line, put in the spot for the milk cup, push the button cold if you want it cold, otherwise just push latte or cap and it beeps when ready. The foam is very nice and stays foamed for a long time (2% cow milk). You can have the "shot" done simultaneously, just push the latte/ cap button and the big K and go. You also have the choice to make a regular coffee and not a shot if you want an 8 10 or 12 oz of coffee but you cant have the milk frotter and the regular coffee mode working at the same time, while the shot can be used at the same time. It's not exactly long but good to know if you want to have foam of you regular coffee or something. It looks very good, easy to clean and you have access to the very very wide Keurig compatible pods or the reusable one if you want to use a specific coffee / be more environmentally responsible (but make sure you buy the right "universal" keurig reusable pod, yes there are 2 options). I like the various flavours to try for ice caps that other machines don't (or you need to buy sugary sirup for a similar taste). The pods are not very expensive compared to Nespresso and you have a wider selection. Only downside: the packaging it comes in is very over the top (3 boxes until you reach the machine...). It's also not a "real" pressure espresso shot like you would have with a nespresso, so if you only drink espressos then it may not be for you but if you want a multifunctions machine it's the best I found. (I'm familiar and often use outside the house nespresso, Tassimo and the basic Keurig and it really is the best of them for my needs).

    Review originally posted on keurig.ca

  • Customer rating: 3 out of 5 stars

    Does what I need but extremely annoying to operate

    Reviewed by Kaya - June 18, 2020

    I bought this product approximately two months ago. While the product makes a decent cup of coffee, and an OK faux latte and tea, it is extremely annoying to operate. It often feels like I am playing a game. I hit buttons and nothing happens. Opening it is supposed to reset it but this doesn't always work and it also seems required at so many points that it gets annoying. For example, when I try to make a latte and froth milk, it often doesn't work. I have to open the lid and try again. It still sometimes doesn't work and then it will just randomly work out of the blue. I sometimes run a shot thru twice but the lid needs to be opened in between and this just makes the machine messy. Also, it doesn't tell you that this is what you need to do so you stand there hitting buttons with no indication why nothing is working. I also make tea, but because I use a large mug, I have to add water twice. Unfortunately I have to open the machine half way through to get it to reset to add more water. To do so means I have to remove the mug and put it back because opening it tilts the spout down and my mug is tall. The machine does all the functions I need it to and for that I am pleased. It even froths milk nicely (most of the time...if the magnet does not become dislodged and after trying to start it three times). The problem is, it's like a game trying to figure out what sequence of buttons you need to press and there are just too many steps that you have to do in the right order to get it to work. Further to that, I find that it's easier to pour water in versus lift the tank because putting it back it doesn't always connect easily and leave water underneath (it also sometimes seems to leave water under the machine). The problem is that there is not a good grip on it so on more than one occasion, the lid has fallen into the tank necessitating removal and washing. It's a nice product but programmed in a manner so as to make it incredibly annoying. Keuring needs to not complicate what should be simple.

    No, I would not recommend this to a friend.
